name: 29617 · Greenville, SC
findings: ZIP 29617 (Greenville) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29617 (Greenville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29617 (Greenville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29617 (Greenville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
